title: Chapter 688 - 688 Space Level Upgrade; Curse Spell!
content:
Chapter 688 - 688 Space Level Upgrade; Curse Spell!

Chapter 688 - 688 Space Level Upgrade; Curse Spell!

688 Space Level Upgrade; Curse Spell!

Cultivation was timeless.

By the time Lin Fan opened his eyes, the ship had already stopped on Revelation Planet.

It was a planet that could enter the Heavenly Wind World.

Lin Fan retracted his aura, and the space power dissipated.

Then, he turned his attention to the system.

[Host: Lin Fan]

[Cultivation: Star Traveller Level 3 (20,000/100,000)]

[Skill: Sword 81]

[Equipment: Star Meteorite Sword]

[Laws: Time (elementary), Space (intermediate), Metal (elementary), Wood (elementary), Water (elementary), Fire (elementary), Earth (elementary)]

[Character Relationship]

[Lin Tao: Father. Favorability: Ten stars]

[Dai Weixue: Mom. Favorability: Ten stars]

[Lin Xiaoyao: Sister: Favorability: Ten stars]

[Xia Xue: Dao Companion: Favorability Ten stars]

[Xia Bing: Dao Companion: Favorability: Ten stars…]

His spatial laws had reached the intermediate level!

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s lips curled up. Indeed, after obtaining Top-Notch Spatial Law Talent, his comprehension ability had increased by quite a bit.

At this moment, a commotion suddenly came from outside.

“Ma Zheng, this is a public parking space. Isn’t it a little presumptuous of you to occupy it?” a middle-aged man with a mustache shouted.

His voice attracted the attention of many people.

“Occupy?” Ma Zheng’s face darkened. “I pay the parking fee on time every day, so how am I occupying it?”

The middle-aged man with a mustache was called Qin Dachuan, and he was also a member of Hong Planet.

He had once fought with Ma Zheng for the position of Star Lord of Hong Planet, but unfortunately, he lost.

Later on, he drifted around the universe.

Now, he had become a manager in Revelation Planet.

In fact, Ma Zheng also wanted to leave the public parking space as soon as possible.

However, the moment the ship arrived at the port, it was restricted by the space energy that Lin Fan was cultivating, making it difficult to move forward.

Ma Zheng was worried that forcefully activating it would disturb Lin Fan, who was cultivating.

Therefore, he decided to stop here and guard the side at all times.

“So what if you pay the parking fee? The public parking lot is only a temporary parking spot. What, do you still think this is Hong Planet? You still think of yourself as the lord of the planet?” Qin Dachuan shouted, “Now, maneuver the spaceship away immediately!”

As soon as he finished speaking, the group of warriors behind him emitted a dense aura.

The surrounding people all looked at him with expressions of anticipation.

Ma Zheng’s expression turned even uglier.

At this moment, a figure landed beside Ma Zheng.

When Ma Zheng saw him, he hurriedly said respectfully, “Senior Lin.”

Lin Fan nodded. “What happened here?””

Thus, Ma Zheng explained the general situation.

Lin Fan said, “It’s been hard on you.”

Qin Dachuan had been carefully sizing Lin Fan up.

At this moment, he also spoke up. “Senior, it’s not that I’m making things difficult for him. It’s just that there are too many flying ships coming and going from Revolution Planet. Especially since the Heavenly Wind World is about to open, the number of flying ships has increased exponentially.

“Therefore, all the public berths are only for temporary parking, but Ma Zheng has been parked here for more than ten days.”

Qin Dachuan’s and Ma Zheng’s cultivation levels were similar.

Ma Zheng was so respectful to Lin Fan that he had to be careful.

That was because Qin Dachuan deeply understood that the strong were respected in this world.

If Lin Fan was really strong, then he would be in danger.

Lin Fan said calmly, “Since that’s the case, let’s leave.”

He did not want to make a big fuss over a small matter.

“Yes, Senior,” Ma Zheng replied respectfully.

With a loud rumble, the interstellar spaceship arrived at the parking bay of Xiuli Hotel.

Lin Fan stood in front of the tall floor-to-ceiling window and looked at the scenery outside. He felt very peaceful.

In the blink of an eye, two days had passed.

…

In a spacious villa.

Qin Dachuan said to the communicator in front of him, “Have you found anything?”

“That person’s name is Lin Fan. Not long ago, he dealt with the Abyss Mystic Realm on the Qing Planet with the Star Lord of the Qing Planet, Qing Song, the Star Lord of the Spirit Planet, Feng Yue, and the Star Lord of the Hong Planet, Qin Dachuan…”

After Qin Dachuan turned off the communicator, a look of disdain appeared on his face.

“Hmph! I was almost scared by him. So, he’s only at the Planet level. No wonder he left after saying a few words!

“Since they came to Revelation Star, they should be entering the Heavenly Wind World. Hmph! They’d better not let me run into them again.”

…

At this moment, Lin Fan, who was resting in Xiuli Hotel, suddenly heard a clear notification in his mind.

[Ding! Qin Dachuan’s hatred toward you has reached two stars.]

When Lin Fan heard this, he could not help but frown.

Why did this guy suddenly hate him?

Hence, he placed his attention on Qin Dachuan’s name.

[Qin Dachuan: Star Traveller Level 2. Because you and Ma Zheng passed by and he misunderstood you as a mighty figure, he felt humiliated and hates you now.]

Did he treat him as an enemy just like that?

Lin Fan took it to heart.

Since they were enemies, he had to be vigilant at all times.

Otherwise, that man might suddenly give him a fatal blow one day.

At this moment, the doorbell rang.

Lin Fan saw that it was Ma Zheng through the video phone. He waved his hand, and the door opened automatically.

“Senior Lin, there’s a trading convention on Daluo Street today. Do you want to go and take a look?” Ma Zheng asked.

“Trading convention?” Lin Fan was puzzled.

“Yes. Everyone knows that there are great opportunities and great dangers in the Heavenly Wind World. Therefore, they’d hold a trading convention before the opening of the Heavenly Wind World. There’ll be medicinal pills, weapons, and others. This way, it’ll be safer in the Heavenly Wind World,” Ma Zheng said.

When Lin Fan heard that, his interest was piqued.

This was definitely a way to gain a deeper understanding of this universe.

“Alright, let’s go and take a look,” Lin Fan said.

Revelation Planet forbade flying.

Lin Fan and Ma Zheng took a luxurious mechanical car to Daluo Street.

It was called a street, but in fact, it was a city. It was very spacious and lively.

When Lin Fan stepped into Daluo Street, a crisp notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! You’ve completed a hidden quest: Entry into the trading convention. Congratulations, you’ve received 100,000 experience and Curse.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve reached Star Traveller Level 4 (20,000/200,000).]

Instantly, a powerful aura spread out from Lin Fan, causing Lin Fan and Ma Zheng’s clothes to rustle.

Ma Zheng’s heart skipped a beat, and he could not help but look at Lin Fan.

He thought to himself, ‘Did Senior Lin became stronger again? He can become stronger even by walking?’

Ma Zheng was even more respectful toward Lin Fan.

Lin Fan did not care about Ma Zheng’s change at all.

He immediately focused his attention on Curse.

[Curse: An Emperor-level skill that possesses powerful curse power. It can cause the cursed person to be plagued by bad luck. It’s extremely evil.]

Seeing this, Lin Fan’s eyes lit up.

Emperor-level skill!

Moreover, this ability seemed to be quite good.
